ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) surface area with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage localized in circular spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigment base; high-contrast white circular blobs ranging 5-20 pixels are distributed across both lobes, showing increased density on the lateral margins and distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central notch with an approximate angle of 105 degrees; notch depth is moderate, extending into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the trailing edge, characterized by pixel-amplitude peaks of 5-15 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the median notch to the lobe tips, with a steep upward curve near the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular white patterns and ring-shaped scars (rosettes) distributed across the ventral surface of both lobes, particularly prominent in the outer-mid regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive yellowish-brown barnacle colonies attached to the distal tips of both the left and right lobes; trailing edge exhibits minor irregular jaggedness.
other_distinctive_markers: The distal tips of the fluke are modified by large, high-contrast yellowish-brown biological masses that differ significantly in color and texture from the fluke surface.
